method: Downloaded complete PDFs by HTTPS curl; extracted page-labelled full text with PyMuPDF; examined the exact text spans described below. Extraction alone is not claimed as reading.

sources.title: Lehrer–Zhang, The Brauer Category and Invariant Theory
sources.read: Complete relevant presentation proof: Definitions 2.3–2.11, Lemmas 2.10–2.13 and completion of Theorem 2.6, PDF pp. 5–12; bending Definitions 2.11/Corollary 2.16 pp.9–10,13; complete §§3.1–3.6 pp.16–18; complete §4 pp.19–22; Theorem 7.3 and proof pp.33–34; reference list pp.38–39.
sources.finding: Theorem 4.8 has a complete categorical deduction but imports Theorems 4.1 and 4.6 from Weyl/Goodman–Wallach. Its stable threshold is d=m for O and m/2 for Sp. Theorem 7.3 has an imported/sketched modular proof, not a self-contained extension. §§5–6 single fixed-algebra kernel generators were not read in full and are not relied on.

sources.title: Roe Goodman, Multiplicity-Free Spaces and Schur-Weyl-Howe Duality
sources.read: Complete §§6.4–6.5, PDF pp.18–19; complete Theorem 7.4 proof and §7.4, pp.21–23; surrounding GL polynomial/tensor discussion pp.17–21 selectively.
sources.finding: Explicit polynomial symmetric-minor/Pfaffian ideals, and complete tensor-polarization deduction were examined. Square-matrix FFT proof is imported as Goodman–Wallach Proposition 4.2.6, and SFT cites Theorems 5.2.17–5.2.18. Full cited book arguments not retrieved/read. This is not evidence that straightening/normality proof was read.

sources.title: Halverson–Ram, Partition Algebras
sources.read: Complete §3 opening action formulas and Theorem 3.6(a),(b) and proof, printed pp.18–20, local extracted text lines3470–3700.
sources.finding: Exact orbit-indicator kernel and stable N≥2r. The direct argument can be reproduced over any field; reverse centralizer in modular characteristic does not follow.

independent_mathematical_checks: Symmetric t×t rank≤m variety dimension mt−m(m−1)/2; lower-rank stratum codimension t−m+1.
Alternating t×t rank≤m, m even, dimension mt−m(m+1)/2; next lower even-rank stratum codimension 2(t−m)+1.
Multidegree extraction excludes overlapping row/column label sets in orthogonal determinant relations and yields Pfaffian size 2n+2 in symplectic dimension 2n.
With B(bar b_i,b_j)=delta_ij, cup c=sum b_i tensor bar b_i has B(c)=epsilon*m and crossing epsilon*flip, hence Sp loop−2n.
Normality, torsor descent and codimension extension are explicit local proof obligations. Merely separating full-rank orbits, proving generators vanish, or citing 4.8 does not establish FFT/SFT.
